Since then we've supported every Classic release, and now we're carrying that forward into <expansion>World of Warcraft®: Forever</expansion>. It's thanks to dozens of developers, hundreds of players, and thousands of hours of time that we've been able to keep the project going so that our users can continue to make the most out of their gameplay.

sim.basic_bis_disclaimer:
Preset gear lists are intended as rough approximations of BIS, and will often not be the absolute highest-DPS setup for you. Your optimal gear setup will depend on many factors; that's why we have a sim!

Items may also be omitted from the presets if they are highly contested and clearly better utilized on other classes, to encourage equitable gearing for the raid as a whole.
sim.healing_sim_disclaimer:
*** WARNING - USE AT YOUR OWN RISK ***

The entire concept of a healing sim is EXPERIMENTAL. All results should be taken with an EXTREMELY large grain of salt.

This tool is currently more similar to a spreadsheet than a true sim. Options for specifying incoming damage profiles in order to have proper reactive rotations have not yet been added.

input_delay.label: Input Delay
input_delay.tooltip: Player input delay, in milliseconds. Specifies the maximum delay on actions that cannot be spell queued, such as spell casts that are waiting on resource gains or waiting for a cooldown to expire. Also used with certain APL values (such as 'Aura Is Active With Reaction Time'). Roughly models the sum of reaction time + server latency.

channel_clip_delay.label: Channel Clip Delay
channel_clip_delay.tooltip: Clip delay following channeled spells, in milliseconds. This delay occurs following any full or partial channel ending after the GCD becomes available, due to the player not being able to queue the next spell.

in_front_of_target.label: In Front of Target
in_front_of_target.tooltip: Stand in front of the target, causing Blocks and Parries to be included in the attack table.

distance_from_target.label: Distance From Target
distance_from_target.tooltip: Distance from targets, in yards. Used to calculate travel time for certain spells.

tank_assignment.label: Tank Assignment
tank_assignment.tooltip: Determines which mobs will be tanked. Most mobs default to targeting the Main Tank, but in preset multi-target encounters this is not always true.

inspiration_uptime.label: Inspiration % Uptime
inspiration_uptime.tooltip:
% average of Encounter Duration, during which you have the Inspiration buff.

If set to 0, the buff isn't applied.

incoming_hps.label: Incoming HPS
incoming_hps.tooltip: Average amount of healing received per second. Used for calculating chance of death. If set to 0, defaults to 25% of the primary target's base DPS.

healing_cadence.label: Healing Cadence
healing_cadence.tooltip: How often the incoming heal 'ticks', in seconds. Generally, longer durations favor Effective Hit Points (EHP) for minimizing Chance of Death, while shorter durations favor avoidance. Example: if Incoming HPS is set to 1000 and this is set to 1s, then every 1s a heal will be received for 1000. If this is instead set to 2s, then every 2s a heal will be recieved for 2000. If set to 0, default values for Healing Cadence and Cadence +/- are inferred from boss damage parameters.

healing_cadence_variation.label: Cadence +/-
healing_cadence_variation.tooltip: Magnitude of random variation in healing intervals, in seconds. Example: if Healing Cadence is set to 1s with 0.5s variation, then the interval between successive heals will vary uniformly between 0.5 and 1.5s. If the variation is instead set to 2s, then 50% of healing intervals will fall between 0s and 1s, and the other 50% will fall between 1s and 3s. The amount of healing per 'tick' is automatically scaled up or down based on the randomized time since the last tick, so as to keep HPS constant.

absorb_frac.label: Absorb %
absorb_frac.tooltip: % of each incoming heal 'tick' to model as an absorb shield rather than as a direct heal.

burst_window.label: TMI Burst Window
burst_window.tooltip: Size in whole seconds of the burst window for calculating TMI. It is important to use a consistent setting when comparing this metric. Default is 6 seconds. If set to 0, TMI calculations are disabled.

hp_percent_for_defensives.label: HP % for Defensive CDs
hp_percent_for_defensives.tooltip: % of Maximum Health, below which defensive cooldowns are allowed to be used. If set to 0, this restriction is disabled.

retribution_aura_spell_power.label: Retribution Aura Spell Power
retribution_aura_spell_power.tooltip: The Holy spell power of the paladin providing Retribution Aura. Each hit you take deals the aura's base damage plus 6% of this.

thorns_spell_power.label: Thorns Spell Power
thorns_spell_power.tooltip: The Nature spell power of the druid providing Thorns. Each hit you take deals Thorns' base damage plus 6% of this.

pet_uptime.label: Pet Uptime (%)
pet_uptime.tooltip: Percent of the fight duration for which your pet will be alive.

pet_type.label: Family
pet_type.tooltip: The family of the tamed creature: its own damage, armor and health, and the abilities it learns.

pet_attack_speed.label: Attack Speed
pet_attack_speed.tooltip: The Faster Attack or Slower Attack passive the tamed creature carries on top of the 2 s swing every pet has.
pet_attack_speed.none: No Faster or Slower Attack (2.0 s swing)

detonate_seed.label: Detonate Seed on Cast
detonate_seed.tooltip: Simulates raid doing damage to targets such that seed detonates immediately on cast.

default_shout.label: Battle Shout
default_shout.tooltip: Whether the warrior keeps its own Battle Shout up (can be overridden in the APL).

default_stance.label: Default Stance

starting_rage.label: Starting Rage
starting_rage.tooltip: Initial rage at the start of each iteration.

stance_snapshot.label: Stance Snapshot
stance_snapshot.tooltip: Ability that is cast at the same time as stance swap will benefit from the bonus of the stance before the swap.

has_bs_tier_2.label: Battle Shout: Battlegear of Wrath
has_bs_tier_2.tooltip: Three pieces of Battlegear of Wrath add 30 attack power to Battle Shout. Set this when the pieces arrive through an item swap rather than the worn set.

has_battle_shout_rank_7.label: Battle Shout: Rank 7
has_battle_shout_rank_7.tooltip: Sets the character sheet's Battle Shout to Rank 7 (Manual of Battle Shout VII) instead of Rank 6. The rotation picks the rank that is cast: the simple rotation's Battle Shout VII toggle, or the rank chosen for the spell in the rotation editor.

queue_delay.label: HS/Cleave Queue Delay (ms)
queue_delay.tooltip: How long (in milliseconds) to delay re-queueing Heroic Strike/Cleave in order to simulate real reaction time and game delay.

assume_bleed_active.label: Assume Bleed Always Active
assume_bleed_active.tooltip: Assume bleed always exists for 'Rend and Tear' calculations and the 'Bleed Is Active' APL condition. Otherwise will only calculate based on your own bleeds.

cannot_shred_target.label: Cannot Shred Target
cannot_shred_target.tooltip: Alternative to "In Front of Target" for modeling bosses that do not Parry or Block, but which you still cannot Shred.

innervate_assignment.label: Innervate
innervate_assignment.tooltip: Self keeps the mana. Someone else still casts Innervate on your rotation, and the mana stays off you.

show_all_enchants.label: Show All

frenzy_time.label: Frenzy time

spiritual_grasp_frequency.label: Spiritual Grasp frequency

reaction_time.label: Reaction Time
reaction_time.tooltip: How long the player can wait for casts to finish before moving in seconds

yards.label: Yards

adds_respawn_time.tooltip: Time for add(s) to respawn after previous died (in seconds)

adds_lifetime.label: Add(s) lifetime

adds_spawn_delay.label: Add(s) spawn delay

duration.label: Duration
duration.tooltip: The fight length for each sim iteration, in seconds.

duration_variation.label: Duration +/-
duration_variation.tooltip: Adds a random amount of time, in seconds, between [value, -1 * value] to each sim iteration. For example, setting Duration to 180 and Duration +/- to 10 will result in random durations between 170s and 190s.

execute_duration_20.label: Execute Duration 20 (%)
execute_duration_20.tooltip: Percentage of the total encounter duration, for which the targets will be considered to be in execute range (< 20% HP) for the purpose of effects like Warrior Execute.

execute_duration_35.label: Execute Duration 35 (%)
execute_duration_35.tooltip: Percentage of the total encounter duration, for which the targets will be considered to be in execute range (< 35% HP).

zone.label: Zone
zone.tooltip: Picks every kind of area the zone counts as; picking a preset boss fills it in from the boss's zone. Custom means the areas below were set by hand.

area_types.label: Area
area_types.tooltip: Every kind of area the fight's zone counts as. Effects that only work in certain areas, such as Rune of the Guard Captain's extra attack power in Forest and Grassland areas, apply when their area is picked. A zone can count as several: Redridge Mountains is Forest and Mountainous, Deadwind Pass is Mountainous, Wasteland and Haunted.

num_allies.label: Num Allies
num_allies.tooltip: Number of allied players in the raid.

min_base_damage.label: Min Base Damage
min_base_damage.tooltip: Base damage for auto attacks, i.e. lowest roll with 0 AP against a 0-armor Player.

ai.label: AI

creature_family.label: Creature Family

tanked_by.label: Tanked By

swing_speed.label: Swing Speed
swing_speed.tooltip: Time in seconds between auto attacks. Set to 0 to disable auto attacks.

dual_wield_penalty.label: Dual Wield Penalty
dual_wield_penalty.tooltip: Enables the Dual Wield Miss Penalty (+19% chance to miss) if dual wielding. Bosses in Hyjal/BT/SWP usually have this disabled to stop tanks from avoidance stacking.

parry_haste.label: Parry Haste
parry_haste.tooltip: Whether this enemy will gain parry haste when parrying attacks.

bleed_immune.label: Immune to Bleeds

can_crush.label: Can Crush
can_crush.tooltip: Whether this enemy can land Crushing Blows (150% damage) against players below its level. Enabled by default for level 73 targets.

spell_school.label: Spell School
spell_school.tooltip: Type of damage caused by auto attacks. This is usually Physical, but some enemies have elemental attacks.

damage_spread.label: Damage Spread
damage_spread.tooltip: Fractional spread between the minimum and maximum auto-attack damage from this enemy at 0 Attack Power.

channel.label: Channel
channel.full_description:
The difference between channeling a spell vs casting the spell is that channels can be interrupted. If the Interrupt If parameter is empty, this action is equivalent to Cast.

The channel will be interrupted only if all of the following are true:

  • Immediately following a tick of the channel
  • The Interrupt If condition evaluates to True
  • Another action in the APL list is available

Note that if you simply want to allow other actions to interrupt the channel, set Interrupt If to True.

interrupt_if.label: Interrupt If
interrupt_if.tooltip: Interrupt the channel if the condition is true.

recast.label: Recast

cast_all_stat_buff_cooldowns.full_description:
• Does not cast cooldowns which are already controlled by other actions in the priority list.
  • By default, this action will cast such cooldowns greedily as they become available. However, when embedded in a sequence, the action will only fire when ALL cooldowns matching the specified buff type(s) are ready.

autocast_other_cooldowns.label: Autocast Other Cooldowns
autocast_other_cooldowns.tooltip: Automatically casts other cooldowns when available.
autocast_other_cooldowns.full_description:
• Does not auto-cast cooldowns which are already controlled by other actions in the priority list.
  • Cooldowns are usually cast immediately upon becoming ready, but there are some basic smart checks in place, e.g. don't use Mana CDs when near full mana.

wait.label: Wait
wait.tooltip: Waits for the specified amount of time.

wait_until.label: Wait Until
wait_until.tooltip: Waits until the specified condition is true.

scheduled_action.label: Scheduled Action
scheduled_action.tooltip: Performs an action at a scheduled time.

do_at.label: Do At
do_at.tooltip: Comma-separated list of timings. The inner action will be performed once at each timing.

do_at.label: Do At
do_at.tooltip: Performs an action at a specific time.

sequence.label: Sequence
sequence.tooltip: A list of sub-actions to execute in the specified order.
sequence.full_description:
Once one of the sub-actions has been performed, the next sub-action will not necessarily be immediately executed next. The system will restart at the beginning of the whole actions list (not the sequence). If the sequence is executed again, it will perform the next sub-action.

When all actions have been performed, the sequence does NOT automatically reset; instead, it will be skipped from now on. Use the Reset Sequence action to reset it, if desired.

reset_sequence.label: Reset Sequence
reset_sequence.tooltip: Restarts a sequence, so that the next time it executes it will perform its first sub-action.
reset_sequence.full_description: Use the name field to refer to the sequence to be reset. The desired sequence must have the same (non-empty) value for its name.

strict_sequence.label: Strict Sequence
strict_sequence.tooltip: Like a regular Sequence, except all sub-actions are executed immediately after each other and the sequence resets automatically upon completion.
strict_sequence.full_description: Strict Sequences do not begin unless ALL sub-actions are ready.

change_target.label: Change Target
change_target.tooltip: Sets the current target, which is the target of auto attacks and most casts by default. Not ready while that unit is already the current target, except as a step of a sequence.

activate_aura_with_stacks.label: Activate Aura With Stacks
activate_aura_with_stacks.tooltip: Activates the specified aura with the given number of stacks.
activate_aura_with_stacks.stacks_tooltip: Desired number of initial aura stacks.

activate_all_stat_buff_proc_auras.label: Activate All Stat Buff Proc Auras
activate_all_stat_buff_proc_auras.tooltip: Activates all item/enchant proc auras that buff the specified stat type(s) using the specified item set.

item_swap.label: Item Swap
item_swap.tooltip: Swaps items, using the swap set specified in Settings.

move.label: Move
move.tooltip: Starts a move to the desired range from target.
move.recheck_tooltip: Looks again every reaction time while walking: stops where you are once the condition is false, and turns to the new range when it changes. The rest of the rotation keeps going meanwhile.
move.duration_tooltip: Amount of time the character should move.
move.move_duration_tooltip: The characters moves for the given duration.

pet_attack.label: Pet Attack
pet_attack.tooltip: Works like /petattack in-game. Tells the pet to move/attack.

start_attack.label: Start Attack
start_attack.tooltip: Works like /startattack in game. Turns the melee attack on, from any range: the off hand's first swing comes half a swing later, so starting it on the way in has the off hand nearer ready on arrival. Starting Auto Shot turns it off again.

warlock_cast_assigned_curse.label: Cast Assigned Curse
warlock_cast_assigned_curse.tooltip: Casts the Curse that warlock is assigned

group_reference.label: Group Reference
group_reference.tooltip: References an action group defined in the Groups section.
group_reference.full_description:
Executes all actions in the referenced group in order. Groups allow you to create reusable action sequences.

Example: If you have a group named "careful_aim" with actions [serpent_sting, chimera_shot, steady_shot], referencing this group will execute those three actions in sequence.
group_reference.group_name_tooltip: Name of the group to reference (must match a group defined in the Groups section)
group_reference.variables_tooltip: Variables to pass to the group. These will override the group's internal variables.

compare.label: Compare
compare.tooltip: Compare two values using the specified operator

math.label: Math
math.tooltip: Perform mathematical operations on two values

max.label: Max
max.tooltip: Get the maximum value from a list of values

min.label: Min
min.tooltip: Get the minimum value from a list of values

all_of.label: All Of
all_of.tooltip: True if ALL of the values are true

any_of.label: Any Of
any_of.tooltip: True if ANY of the values are true

not.label: Not
not.tooltip: True if the value is false

current_time_percent.label: Current Time %
current_time_percent.tooltip: Current time as a percentage of the encounter duration

remaining_time_percent.label: Remaining Time %
remaining_time_percent.tooltip: Remaining time as a percentage of the encounter duration

is_execute_phase.label: Is Execute Phase
is_execute_phase.tooltip: True if we are in the execute phase (target health below threshold)

num_targets.label: Number of Targets
num_targets.tooltip: Number of targets in the encounter

spell_is_casting.label: Spell Is Casting
spell_is_casting.tooltip: True while the spell is hardcast, through the rotation's pick at its end. not(Spell Is Casting X) on a line decides it after X lands, for a line that reads what X's landing may change.

spell_time_to_ready.label: Spell Time to Ready
spell_time_to_ready.tooltip: Time until the spell will be ready

in_front_of_target.label: In Front of Target
in_front_of_target.tooltip: True if we are in front of the target

boss_cast.label: Boss Cast
boss_cast.tooltip: True if the boss is casting the specified spell

boss_cast_time_to_ready.label: Boss Cast Time to Ready
boss_cast_time_to_ready.tooltip: Time until the boss spell will be ready

boss_current_target.label: Is Tanking
boss_current_target.tooltip: True if the player is currently tanking

target_is_mob_type.label: Target Is Mob Type
target_is_mob_type.tooltip: True if the target is the chosen creature type

target_is_bleed_immune.label: Target Is Bleed Immune
target_is_bleed_immune.tooltip: True if Immune to Bleeds is on for the target in the encounter settings

encounter_in_area.label: In Area
encounter_in_area.tooltip: True if the encounter's areas include the chosen area type

unit_is_moving.label: Unit Is Moving
unit_is_moving.tooltip: True if the unit is moving

unit_movement_speed.label: Movement Speed
unit_movement_speed.tooltip: Run speed of the unit in yards per second, with its speed effects (7 for a player with none)

current_health_percent.label: Current Health %
current_health_percent.tooltip: Current health as a percentage of max health

current_mana.label: Current Mana
current_mana.tooltip: Amount of currently available Mana of the unit.

current_mana_percent.label: Current Mana (%)
current_mana_percent.tooltip: Amount of currently available Mana of the unit, as a percentage.

current_mana_regen.label: Current Mana Regen
current_mana_regen.tooltip: Current mana regen per second while casting

estimated_time_to_target_focus.label: Estimated Time To Target Focus
estimated_time_to_target_focus.tooltip: Estimated time until target Focus is reached, will return 0 if at or above target.

time_to_next_energy_tick.label: Time To Next Energy Tick
time_to_next_energy_tick.tooltip: Time remaining until the next Energy tick.

estimated_time_to_target_energy.label: Estimated Time To Target Energy
estimated_time_to_target_energy.tooltip: Estimated time until target Energy is reached, will return 0 if at or above target.

current_combo_points.label: Current Combo Points
current_combo_points.tooltip: Amount of currently available Combo Points.

max_combo_points.label: Max Combo Points
max_combo_points.tooltip: Amount of maximum available Combo Points.

gcd_is_ready.label: GCD Is Ready
gcd_is_ready.tooltip: True if the GCD is not on cooldown, otherwise False.

gcd_time_to_ready.label: GCD Time To Ready
gcd_time_to_ready.tooltip: Amount of time remaining before the GCD comes off cooldown, or 0 if it is not on cooldown.

auto_swing_time.label: Auto Swing Time
auto_swing_time.tooltip: Total swing duration including all haste buffs. Wand returns the wand speed with cast speed applied, which a Shoot channel fixes when it starts.

time_to_next_auto.label: Time To Next Auto
time_to_next_auto.tooltip: Amount of time remaining before the next Main-hand, Off-hand, Ranged or Wand attack, or 0 if autoattacks are not engaged. Any includes the wand's next shot while Shoot is channeling. Wand reads 0 while Shoot is not channeling.

time_since_last_auto.label: Time Since Last Auto
time_since_last_auto.tooltip: Amount of time since the last Main-hand, Off-hand, Ranged or Wand attack, or 0 if autoattacks are not engaged. Any includes the last wand shot. Wand reads the time since the last shot, or the time since the pull before the first shot.

spell_known.label: Spell Known
spell_known.tooltip: True if the spell is currently known, otherwise False.

talent_known.label: Talent Known
talent_known.tooltip: True if the talent has at least the chosen rank, otherwise False.

talent_rank.label: Talent Rank
talent_rank.tooltip: The rank the player holds in the talent, 0 without points.

current_cost.label: Current Cost
current_cost.tooltip: Returns current resource cost of spell

can_cast.label: Can Cast
can_cast.tooltip: True if all requirements for casting the spell are currently met, otherwise False.
can_cast.full_description: The Cast Spell action does not need to be conditioned on this, because it applies this check automatically.

in_range.label: In Range
in_range.tooltip: True if you stand within the spell's range, otherwise False.
in_range.full_description: Checks the distance only: no closer than the spell's minimum range and no farther than its maximum, range talents included. A bow, gun or crossbow shot's minimum range is the dead zone, so Arcane Shot being in range means your Auto Shot can fire from here.

is_hit_capped.label: Is Hit Capped
is_hit_capped.tooltip: True if the spell cannot miss the current target, otherwise False.
is_hit_capped.full_description:
Melee and ranged attacks use the special-attack (soft) hit cap, without the dual-wield penalty of auto attacks. Wand shots count physical and ranged hit. Other spells count spell hit and school hit, and a binary spell also counts the target's resistance.

The check reads only the spell's defense type. It does not know that shouts and seals always hit, or that Judgement rolls its miss through another spell.

is_expertise_capped.label: Is Expertise Capped
is_expertise_capped.tooltip: True if the current target can neither dodge nor parry the spell, otherwise False.
is_expertise_capped.full_description:
Parry counts only when you are in front of the target. Spells and ranged attacks cannot be dodged or parried and always return True.

Specials that cannot be dodged, parried or blocked, such as Ambush, Garrote, Overpower and the seal judgements, also return True.

is_ready.label: Is Ready
is_ready.tooltip: True if the spell is not on cooldown, otherwise False.

time_to_ready.label: Time To Ready
time_to_ready.tooltip: Amount of time remaining before the spell comes off cooldown, or 0 if it is not on cooldown.

cast_time.label: Cast Time
cast_time.tooltip: Amount of time to cast the spell including any haste and spell cast time adjustments.

travel_time.label: Travel Time
travel_time.tooltip: Amount of time for the spell to travel to the target.

cpm.label: CPM
cpm.tooltip: Casts Per Minute for the spell so far in the current iteration.

is_casting.label: Is Casting
is_casting.tooltip: True if this spell is currently being cast, otherwise False. The rotation picks its next spell at the cast end, before this one lands, so this guards lines that read what the spell will do. A channel is Is Channeling.

is_channeling.label: Is Channeling
is_channeling.tooltip: True if this spell is currently being channeled, otherwise False.

channeled_ticks.label: Channeled Ticks
channeled_ticks.tooltip: The number of completed ticks in the current channel of this spell, or 0 if the spell is not being channeled.

number_of_charges.label: Number of Charges
number_of_charges.tooltip: The number of charges that are currently available for the spell.

time_to_next_charge.label: Time to next Charge
time_to_next_charge.tooltip: The time until the next charge is available. 0 if spell has all charges avaialable.

gcd_hasted_duration.label: GCD Hasted Duration
gcd_hasted_duration.tooltip: The duration of the GCD induced by a cast with the current haste

full_cooldown.label: Full Cooldown
full_cooldown.tooltip: The full cooldown duration of the spell

channel_clip_delay.label: Channel Clip Delay
channel_clip_delay.tooltip: The amount of time specified by the Channel Clip Delay setting.

input_delay.label: Input Delay
input_delay.tooltip: The amount of time specified by the Input Dleay setting.

spell_in_flight.label: Spell in Flight
spell_in_flight.tooltip: True if this spell is currently in flight, otherwise False.

spell_expected_dpet.label: Spell Expected DPET
spell_expected_dpet.tooltip: The expected damage of a spell if you cast it now, assuming it lands. Includes cast time, GCD time, and averaged crit. Only damage that lands before the fight ends counts.

aura_known.label: Aura Known
aura_known.tooltip: True if the aura is currently known, otherwise False.

aura_active.label: Aura Active
aura_active.tooltip: True if the aura is currently active AND it has been active for at least as long as the player reaction time (configured in Settings), otherwise False.

aura_active_with_reaction_time.label: [DEPRECATED] Aura Active (with Reaction Time)
aura_active_with_reaction_time.tooltip: All Aura checks now contain Reaction Time logic, so this is no longer needed. Use instead.

aura_inactive.label: Aura Inactive
aura_inactive.tooltip: True if the aura is not currently active AND it has been inactive for at least as long as the player reaction time (configured in Settings), otherwise False.

aura_inactive_with_reaction_time.label: [DEPRECATED] Aura Inactive (with Reaction Time)
aura_inactive_with_reaction_time.tooltip: All Aura checks now contain Reaction Time logic, so this is no longer needed. Use instead.

aura_remaining_time.label: Aura Remaining Time
aura_remaining_time.tooltip: Time remaining before this aura will expire, or 0 if the aura is not currently active.

aura_num_stacks.label: Aura Num Stacks
aura_num_stacks.tooltip: Number of stacks of the aura.

aura_should_refresh.label: Aura Should Refresh
aura_should_refresh.tooltip: Whether this aura should be refreshed, e.g. for the purpose of maintaining a debuff.
aura_should_refresh.full_description:
This condition checks not only the specified aura but also any other auras on the same unit, including auras applied by other raid members, which apply the same debuff category.

For example, 'Should Refresh Debuff(Sunder Armor)' will return False if the unit has an active Expose Armor aura.

aura_duration.label: Aura Duration
aura_duration.tooltip: The full cooldown duration of the aura
aura_duration.full_description: Returns the full duration the aura is set to when it is (re)applied, not the time remaining on the current application.

all_item_stat_procs_active.label: All Item Proc Buffs Active
all_item_stat_procs_active.tooltip: True if all item/enchant procs that buff the specified stat type(s) are currently active, otherwise False.
all_item_stat_procs_active.full_description: For stacking proc buffs, this condition also checks that the buff has been stacked to its maximum possible strength.

any_item_stat_procs_active.label: Any Item Proc Buff Active
any_item_stat_procs_active.tooltip: True if any item/enchant procs that buff the specified stat type(s) are currently active, otherwise False.
any_item_stat_procs_active.full_description: For stacking proc buffs, this condition also checks that the buff has been stacked to its maximum possible strength.

any_item_stat_procs_available.label: Any Item Proc Buff Available
any_item_stat_procs_available.tooltip: True if any item/enchant procs that buff the specified stat type(s) are currently not on ICD and aren't active, otherwise False.

item_procs_min_remaining_time.label: Item Procs Min Remaining Time
item_procs_min_remaining_time.tooltip: Shortest remaining duration on any active item/enchant procs that buff the specified stat type(s), or infinity if none are currently active.

item_procs_max_remaining_icd.label: Item Procs Max Remaining ICD
item_procs_max_remaining_icd.tooltip: Longest remaining ICD on any inactive item/enchant procs that buff the specified stat type(s), or 0 if all are currently active.

num_equipped_stat_proc_items.label: Num Equipped Stat Proc Effects
num_equipped_stat_proc_items.tooltip: Number of equipped passive item/enchant effects that buff the specified stat type(s) when they proc.

num_stat_buff_cooldowns.label: Num Stat Buff Cooldowns
num_stat_buff_cooldowns.tooltip: Number of registered Major Cooldowns that buff the specified stat type(s) when they are cast.
num_stat_buff_cooldowns.full_description: Both manually casted cooldowns as well as cooldowns controlled by "Cast All Stat Buff Cooldowns" and "Autocast Other Cooldowns" actions are included in the total count returned by this value.

any_stat_buff_cooldowns_active.label: Any Stat Buff Cooldowns Active
any_stat_buff_cooldowns_active.tooltip: True if any registered Major Cooldowns that buff the specified stat type(s) are currently active, otherwise False.
any_stat_buff_cooldowns_active.full_description:
For stacking buffs, this condition also checks that the buff has been stacked to its maximum possible strength after the cooldown is activated.

Both manually casted cooldowns as well as cooldowns controlled by "Cast All Stat Buff Cooldowns" and "Autocast Other Cooldowns" actions are checked.

any_stat_buff_cooldowns_min_duration.label: Any Stat Buff Cooldowns Min Remaining Time
any_stat_buff_cooldowns_min_duration.tooltip: Shortest remaining duration on any registered Major Cooldown that buff the specified stat type(s), or infinity if none are currently active.
any_stat_buff_cooldowns_min_duration.full_description: Both manually casted cooldowns as well as cooldowns controlled by "Cast All Stat Buff Cooldowns" and "Autocast Other Cooldowns" actions are checked.

dot_is_active.label: Dot Is Active
dot_is_active.tooltip: True if the specified dot is currently ticking, otherwise False.

druid_bleed_is_active.label: Bleed Is Active
druid_bleed_is_active.tooltip: True if one of your bleeds is on the target, or if Assume Bleed Always Active is enabled, otherwise False.

druid_excess_energy.label: Excess Energy
druid_excess_energy.tooltip: Your current Energy minus what you need to keep for your upcoming Rip and Rake refreshes, after counting the Energy you will regenerate before each one. Spend on a builder only while it covers the builder's cost.

dot_is_active_on_all_targets.label: Dot Is Active On All Targets
dot_is_active_on_all_targets.tooltip: True if the specified dot is currently ticking on all targets, otherwise False.

dot_remaining_time.label: Dot Remaining Time
dot_remaining_time.tooltip: Time remaining before the last tick of this DoT will occur, or 0 if the DoT is not currently ticking.

dot_lowest_remaining_time.label: Dot Lowest Remaining Time
dot_lowest_remaining_time.tooltip: Time remaining before the last tick of this DoT on any target will occur, or 0 if the DoT is not currently ticking.

dot_time_to_next_tick.label: Dot Time To Next Tick
dot_time_to_next_tick.tooltip: The time remaining until the next tick of this DoT will occur.

dot_percent_increase.label: Dot Damage Increase %
dot_percent_increase.tooltip: How much stronger a new DoT would be compared to the old.

sequence_is_complete.label: Sequence Is Complete
sequence_is_complete.tooltip: True if there are no more subactions left to execute in the sequence, otherwise False.

sequence_is_ready.label: Sequence Is Ready
sequence_is_ready.tooltip: True if the next subaction in the sequence is ready to be executed, otherwise False.

sequence_time_to_ready.label: Sequence Time To Ready
sequence_time_to_ready.tooltip: Returns the amount of time remaining until the next subaction in the sequence will be ready.

totem_remaining_time.label: Totem Remaining Time
totem_remaining_time.tooltip: Returns the amount of time remaining until the totem will expire.

warlock_assigned_curse_is_active.label: Assigned Curse Is Active
warlock_assigned_curse_is_active.tooltip: Returns true is assigned curse is active on target

warlock_assigned_curse_is_active_on_all_.label: Assigned Curse Is Active On All Targets
warlock_assigned_curse_is_active_on_all_.tooltip: True while your assigned curse is on every target, otherwise False. With no curse assigned it is False.

warlock_bane_is_active_on_all_targets.label: Bane Is Active On All Targets
warlock_bane_is_active_on_all_targets.tooltip: True while one of your Banes (Agony, Doom or Havoc) is on every target, otherwise False. A target holds one Bane at a time.

warlock_is_assigned_curse.label: Is Assigned Curse
warlock_is_assigned_curse.tooltip: True if the warlock is assigned the specified curse

warlock_active_pet.label: Active Pet Is
warlock_active_pet.tooltip: True while the specified demon is out. No Pet is true while no demon is.

protection_paladin_damage_taken_last_glo.label: Damage Taken Last Global
protection_paladin_damage_taken_last_glo.tooltip: Amount of damage taken in the last 1.5s.

aura_remaining_icd.label: Aura Remaining ICD
aura_remaining_icd.tooltip: Time remaining before this aura's internal cooldown will be ready, or 0 if the ICD is ready now.

aura_icd_is_ready.label: Aura ICD Is Ready
aura_icd_is_ready.tooltip: True if the aura's ICD is currently ready OR it was put on CD recently, within the player's reaction time (configured in Settings), otherwise False.

aura_icd_is_ready_with_reaction_time.label: [DEPRECATED] Aura ICD Is Ready (with Reaction Time)
aura_icd_is_ready_with_reaction_time.tooltip: All Aura checks now contain Reaction Time logic, so this is no longer needed. Use Aura ICD Is Ready instead.

overlap.label: Overlap
overlap.tooltip: Maximum amount of time before the aura expires when it may be refreshed.

multiple_cd_usages.label: Multiple CD Usages
multiple_cd_usages.tooltip:
Will try to fit the selected Target spell within the cooldown of the selected Base spell.
If you lose a 2nd cast of Death Wish whilst waiting for a delayed Bloodlust (using the offset) it will cast Death Wish earlier.
multiple_cd_usages.base_spell_tooltip: The spell (ie. Bloodlust) you are casting that can have multiple other spells within it's cooldown
multiple_cd_usages.target_spell_tooltip: The spell (ie. Death Wish) you want to fit within the cooldown of the Base Spell.
multiple_cd_usages.align_cd_end: Align target spell to encounter end
multiple_cd_usages.align_cd_end_tooltip: When checked, aligns the target spell to the end of the encounter, which is useful for cooldowns or specs that benefit from execute. Without a base spell it casts early while a later use would still get at least half its buff before the encounter ends, and otherwise holds it until its buff runs to the end of the encounter. The offset only applies with a base spell.

selected_potion.label: Selected Potion
selected_potion.tooltip: Returns True if the potion is picked in the chosen potion slot, or with Any in any of them: offensive, defensive or resource.

selected_conjured.label: Selected Conjured
selected_conjured.tooltip: Returns True if the selected conjured item is the character's default conjured item.

offset.label: Offset
offset.tooltip: The time offset from which when the cooldown will be triggered

dot_base_duration.label: Dot Base Duration
dot_base_duration.tooltip: The base duration of the DoT.

dot_tick_rate_percent_increase.label: Dot Tick Rate Increase %
dot_tick_rate_percent_increase.tooltip: How much faster a new DoT would tick compared to the old.

variable_placeholder.label: Variable Placeholder
variable_placeholder.tooltip: Placeholder value that gets replaced when group is referenced
variable_placeholder.full_description:
Defines a placeholder value that must be set when this group is referenced. This allows groups to be parameterized.

Example: If you add a Variable Placeholder named "replace", then when referencing this group, you must provide a value for "replace".
variable_placeholder.name_tooltip: Name of the variable placeholder to expose. This name will be used when referencing the group.

action_group_used.label: Action Group is used
action_group_used.tooltip: Returns True if the specified action group is used in the rotation. This allows you to conditionally execute actions based on whether an action group is included in the rotation.

active_item_swap_set.label: Item Swap
active_item_swap_set.tooltip: Returns True if the specified item swap set is currently active.

field_configs.min_icd_tooltip: If non-zero, filter out any procs that either lack an ICD or for which the ICD is smaller than the specified value (in seconds). This can be useful for certain snapshotting checks, since procs with low ICDs are often too weak to snapshot.
field_configs.include_reaction_time_tooltip: If checked, will use the configured reaction time.
field_configs.use_base_value_tooltip: If checked, will compare the current DoT to the the base value (on encounter start) of the DoT.

helpers.placeholder_tooltip: The potion of this class picked in the Consumables, before the pull or in combat.

auto.description: Automatically using a Saved Rotation based on your current settings.

cooldowns.title: Cooldowns
cooldowns.tooltip:
Specify cooldown timings, in seconds. Cooldowns will be used as soon as possible after their specified timings. When not specified, cooldowns will be used when ready and it is sensible to do so.

Multiple timings can be provided by separating with commas. Any cooldown usages after the last provided timing will use the default logic.

alerts.choose_name: Choose a label for your saved rotation!

siml.title: SIML
siml.tooltip: SIML is the sim's text format. Export the rotation to read or edit it as text, and import it back.

apply_poisons_manually.label: Configure poisons manually
apply_poisons_manually.tooltip: Prevent automatic poison configuration that is based on equipped weapons.

honor_of_thieves_crit_rate.label: Honor of Thieves Crit Rate
honor_of_thieves_crit_rate.tooltip: Number of crits other group members generate within 100 seconds

exhale_window.label: Soul Swap Exhale Window
exhale_window.tooltip: How long, in milliseconds, before inhaled dots expire to exhale during multitarget encounters.

use_shadow_bolt_rank_10.label: Use Shadow Bolt Rank 10
use_shadow_bolt_rank_10.tooltip: Casts Shadow Bolt Rank 10, taught by the Grimoire of Shadow Bolt X, in place of Rank 9 from the trainer.

use_immolate_rank_8.label: Use Immolate Rank 8
use_immolate_rank_8.tooltip: Casts Immolate Rank 8, taught by the Grimoire of Immolate VIII, in place of Rank 7 from the trainer.

use_corruption_rank_7.label: Use Corruption Rank 7
use_corruption_rank_7.tooltip: Casts Corruption Rank 7, taught by the Grimoire of Corruption VII, in place of Rank 6 from the trainer.

playstyle.label: Playstyle
playstyle.tooltip: Where the hunter stands. Turret stays at range. Melee weave walks in for each main hand swing, Raptor Strike riding it, and back out to shoot. Melee stays in melee range.

pull_range.label: Pull range (yd)
pull_range.tooltip: Where you stand when the pull starts. From there you walk to your spot (12 yd at range, 13.2 yd when weaving, melee range in melee), stopping for each Auto Shot you can fire on the way.

time_to_weave.label: Time to weave (ms)
time_to_weave.tooltip: How long, in milliseconds, you stay in melee after the weave swing before walking back out. Never shorter than your input delay.

use_aimed.label: Use Aimed Shot
use_aimed.tooltip: Casts Aimed Shot on cooldown. It shares its cooldown with Multi-Shot.

use_multi.label: Use Multi-Shot
use_multi.tooltip: Includes Multi-Shot as a filler in the rotation. It shares its cooldown with Aimed Shot.

use_arcane.label: Use Arcane Shot
use_arcane.tooltip: Include Arcane Shot as a filler in the rotation. It shares its cooldown with Summon Hawk.

use_sniper.label: Use Sniper Shot
use_sniper.tooltip: Opens the fight with Sniper Shot and casts it whenever no other shot is ready.

use_hawk.label: Use Summon Hawk

welcome.title: Welcome to WoWSims
welcome.body: A short look around the page, from your gear to a finished sim. Move through it with the left and right arrow keys, or skip it any time; Sim Options can start it again.

gear_tab.title: Gear
gear_tab.body: This tab is your character's equipment: what you wear and the presets to start from.

import.title: Import
import.body: Bring in your character with the <addon>WoWSims Exporter addon</addon>, or a build from a link someone shared.

gear_list.title: Your equipment
gear_list.body: Every slot with the item in it, its enchant and gems.

gear_picker.title: Change an item
gear_picker.body: Click a slot to open the gear picker. Choose the item there, then its enchant and gems.

gear_presets.title: Gear sets
gear_presets.body: Load a preset to start from, including sets from the community, or save your own and load it again later.

enchants.title: Optimize enchants
enchants.body: Let the sim choose your enchants for the best result. The cog next to it sets what it aims for.

settings_tab.title: Settings
settings_tab.body: Everything around your character for the sim: the fight, your race and professions, consumables, buffs and debuffs.

encounter.title: Encounter
encounter.body: The fight: how long it lasts, the target, and how much it varies.

player.title: Player
player.body: Your race, professions and the other things about your character that change the numbers.

other.title: Spec settings
other.body: Fight settings only this spec has.

consumables.title: Consumables
consumables.body: Potions, flasks, food and the rest you bring to the fight.

buffs.title: Raid buffs and debuffs
buffs.body: What your raid or party gives you, and the debuffs on the target.

settings_presets.title: Save your settings
settings_presets.body: Load a preset encounter or settings, or save your own and load them again later.

talents_tab.title: Talents
talents_tab.body: Pick your talents here, load a preset, or save your own build.

rotation_tab.title: Rotation
rotation_tab.body: How the sim plays your character in the fight.

rotation_auto.title: Automatic rotation
rotation_auto.body: Auto picks the community's best rotation for your talents, so most players can leave it as it is.

rotation_type.title: Build your own
rotation_type.body: Choose APL here to write your own rotation, action by action.

rotation_presets.title: Preset rotations
rotation_presets.body: Click a preset to load a ready-made rotation. With APL selected, it shows the preset's full list of actions to read or change, and you can save your own here too.

simulate.title: Run the sim
simulate.body: Press Simulate to run the fight with everything you have set. The tour moves on by itself when the run finishes.

result.title: Your result
result.body: Your DPS from that run, and how much it varies from fight to fight. It updates every time you run the sim.

results_tab.title: Results
results_tab.body: The details of the last run. Each tab shows one part of it.

results_damage.title: Damage
results_damage.body: Damage by ability: how much each one did, how often it hit and crit.

results_threat.title: Threat
results_threat.body: Threat by ability, for keeping the target on you or off you.

results_damage_taken.title: Damage taken
results_damage_taken.body: What hit you, and how much of it you avoided.

results_buffs.title: Buffs
results_buffs.body: How often each buff was up on you.

results_debuffs.title: Debuffs
results_debuffs.body: How often each debuff was up on the target.

results_casts.title: Casts
results_casts.body: How many times you cast each ability.

results_resources.title: Resources
results_resources.body: What you spent and gained, such as mana, rage or energy.

results_timeline.title: Timeline
results_timeline.body: One fight laid out over time: casts, buffs and resources.

results_log.title: Log
results_log.body: Every event of one fight, line by line.

bulk_tab.title: Batch sim
bulk_tab.body: Sim many gear combinations at once to find the best of the items you have.

stat_weights.title: Stat weights
stat_weights.body: Work out how much each stat is worth to you, and set the weights the gear picker and enchant optimizer use.

finish.title: You're set
finish.body: There is more to find on the page as you go. If you have a question or something looks wrong, ask us on <discord>Discord</discord>.

suggest_reforges.title: Optimize Enchants
suggest_reforges.freeze_item_slots_tooltip: Flag one or more item slots to be "frozen", which will prevent the optimizer from changing that slot from its current settings. This can be useful for hybrid classes who use the same gear piece for multiple raid roles.
suggest_reforges.stat_caps_tooltip: Stat caps are the most of a stat the optimizer will add. If a stat exceeds its cap, the optimizer will attempt to reduce it to the cap value.
suggest_reforges.breakpoint_limit_tooltip: Allows you to set a custom breakpoint limit.
suggest_reforges.breakpoints_implemented: The following breakpoints have been implemented for this spec:
suggest_reforges.reforge_optimization_failed: Enchant optimization failed. Please try again, or report the issue if it persists.
suggest_reforges.enable_modification: This will enable modification of the default EP weights and setting custom stat caps.
suggest_reforges.modify_in_editor: Ep weights can be modified in the Stat Weights editor.
suggest_reforges.hard_cap_info: If you want to hard cap a stat make sure to put the EP for that stat higher.
suggest_reforges.skipped_slots_description: The following slots need to be simmed because they contain dynamic item effects (such as procs):
suggest_reforges.skipped_slots_unlisted: No checked enchant preset lists these slots:
suggest_reforges.use_enchant_presets_tooltip: Pick enchants only from the checked enchant presets, the same presets the Batch Sim uses. A slot no checked preset lists keeps its enchant.
suggest_reforges.no_enchant_preset: Check at least one enchant preset to optimize enchants.

progress.title: Optimizing Enchants
progress.lengthy: Enchant optimization can be a lengthy process, especially as specific stat caps and breakpoints come into play for classes. This may take a while, but be assured that the calculation will eventually complete.
progress.cancel_hint: You may cancel this operation at any time using the button below.

suggest_reforges.no_result: Native Go gear optimizer did not return optimized gear.

apm.label: APM
apm.tooltip: Actions Per Minute: the spells, abilities and items the rotation uses by hand per minute, plus the walks the rotation or the encounter starts. Abilities that queue for the next swing, such as Heroic Strike, count once when pressed. Procs, auto attacks, walks a spell such as Charge starts, and pets are not counted.

tooltip.title: Theck-Meloree Index (TMI)
tooltip.description: A measure of incoming damage smoothness which combines the benefits of avoidance with effective health.
tooltip.note: Lower is better. This represents the % of your HP to expect in a 6-second burst window based on the encounter settings.

tooltip.title: Chance of Death
tooltip.description: The percentage of iterations in which the player died, based on incoming damage from the enemies and incoming healing (see the Incoming HPS and Healing Cadence options).
tooltip.note: DTPS alone is not a good measure of tankiness because it is not affected by health and ignores damage spikes. Chance of Death attempts to capture overall tankiness.
